parts.text:
It was a beautiful, sunny morning in the green village.
Rand, Hammoudah, and Panda were sitting on the grass eating sweet apples.
The silly seagull was trying to steal a small piece of bread.

Suddenly, Bobby the dog stopped playing with his favorite ball.
He raised his ears and looked straight at the distant mountains.
He started barking loudly, trying to warn his friends.

A few moments later, the ground beneath them began to shake slightly.
The red apples rolled off the picnic blanket and into the dirt.
Rand and Hammoudah stood up quickly, looking around in surprise.

The friends looked up at the bright blue sky above the hills.
A huge cloud of dark black smoke was slowly covering the sun.
The shadow of the smoke made the village look cold and scary.
Big robots walked out of the smoke. They had bright blue eyes and made loud noises as they marched toward the quiet village.

One angry robot walked close to the wooden village gate.
It slowly raised its heavy arm to start destroying the village.

Panda quickly jumped in front of the kids to protect them.
He stood tall and strong, ready to push the robot away.
Beside him, Hammoudah bravely picked up a thick wooden stick from the ground.

segments.text: Rand looked at the big robots, and had a smart idea. She pointed at the muddy place near the river.
"Let's make them walk into the deep mud!" she said loudly.

parts.text:
The silly seagull flew up to the robots' blue eyes.
It flapped its wings and made a loud sound.

segments.text: The angry robots forgot the village and chased the silly seagull.
The bird flew, and the robots walked straight into the deep mud.

parts.text:
Splash! The robots stepped into the sticky mud.
Their heavy legs sank fast, and they got stuck.

The robots stopped moving, stuck in the deep mud.
The village was safe from the scary robots.
Rand, Hammoudah, Panda, and Bobby were very happy in the sun.
Sami is A good boy. He has a cute little white cat. Her name is Bella. Bella is always very hungry. Sami gives her sweet good food.
Bella eats all the food fast. But then, poor Bella feels very bad. She is sick. Her hot head hurts. Sami is very sad for his cute cat friend.
Bella cannot eat any food now. Bella cannot drink cold clean water. She is very sick today. Sami puts his sick cat in a soft warm bed to sleep.
The next day, Bella is still very sick inside. She feels too cold. Sami calls the good animal doctor. "Please help my sick cat again," Sami says sadly.

segments.text: The doctor comes quickly to Sami's home. He looks at quiet Bella in the bed.
"Your cat is really sick," the doctor says. "She needs strong good medicine now."

parts.text: The doctor gives Sami some new medicine. "Give this medicine to Bella every day," he says. "The medicine will help her sick head feel very much better soon."
Sami carefully gives the medicine to poor Bella. He also makes some warm chicken soup. Warm soup is always very good healthy food for a sick cat to eat.

segments.text: Bella eats the nice warm soup. She takes the good red medicine fast.
Then, she goes to sleep deeply in her small bed. Sleep helps her feel well again.
In the beautiful early morning, Bella wakes up. She is not sick at all now.
Her head does not hurt today. She feels very well, active and very happy.
Sami is very happy now, too. His cute cat Bella is completely well.
They eat more good food and play together. Bella is a very happy cat again today.

parts.text:
Early in the morning, Sarah wakes up and calls Khadija.
Khadija: "Good morning, Sarah."
Sarah: "Good morning! What do you think about going today to prepare for the school project?"
Khadija: "Good idea, let's meet at 10:00."

Khadija washes her face and sits with the family in the kitchen for breakfast. Her father is watching TV. He loves sports programs. After that, she helps her mom, puts on her clothes, and meets Sarah at 10:00 to go to the market.

They go out together and walk down the street towards the market. Khadija is chatting with her father on her mobile, asking him to send her some money to her bank card so she can buy the supplies for the project.
They arrive at the store and buy pens, colors, and paper. Sarah (smiling): "This is great for our project." After shopping, they feel hungry and decide to go get lunch.

At the restaurant, they eat chicken and drink water. Sarah's mother calls to ask how much time they need to come back. Sarah: "We will be back soon, Mom. Don't worry, we bought all the project supplies."

While walking after lunch, a thief suddenly tries to steal Sarah's mobile. Sarah falls hard on the ground and hurts her arm. Khadija quickly grabs a wooden stick and hits the thief, knocking him to the ground!
Khadija calls the police and the ambulance for help. She tries to call Sarah's house, but the landline is busy. Then she calls her father to tell him what happened.

The police arrive to arrest the thief, and the girls go to the hospital. The doctor checks Sarah's arm and puts a bandage on it. Doctor: "You are a brave girl and you will be fine." Sarah looks at Khadija and says: "Thank you. You are the brave one."
The girls go back home safely, feeling very tired after a long day. Sarah: "I can't go online or send an email at the moment, I just need to rest."
The girls put on their pajamas and brush their teeth. Sarah turns off the light and gets into bed. Sarah: "Goodnight, Khadija. Tomorrow will be a much better day."

parts.text:
Ali and his friend Tom wanted to go fishing today.
Tom is from another country; his nationality is British.
They both love the sea and small boats.

Before leaving, Ali turned on the TV.
He changed the channel to find the news.
They needed to check the weather first.

The weather forecast said it was a bad day.
The news reporter looked very serious.
He asked everyone to stay safe at home.

The reporter gave more information to the people.
He said a big storm was coming fast.
It was a dangerous hurricane, not just rain.

He said the wind will move at a very high speed.
The sea waves will be very tall and scary.
Going to the beach was a very bad idea.

Ali looked at Tom and said, "We cannot go."
Tom said, "Yes, it is better to stay inside."
They closed the windows and locked the doors.
parts.htmlText: Ali looked at Tom and said, "We cannot go." Tom said, "Yes, it is better to stay inside." They closed the windows and locked the doors.

parts.text:
"What should we do now?" asked Tom.
Ali said, "I know you like animals."
"Let's watch a nice program on TV."

They found a documentary about the ocean.
It showed the deep sea and colorful plants.
They sat on the sofa and ate some popcorn.

Suddenly, a big blue fish appeared on the screen.
Tom smiled and said, "Wow, look at that!"
Ali laughed and said, "It is very beautiful."

They stayed safe and warm all day long.
The storm passed, and the sun came out again.
They promised to try their trip tomorrow instead.
When the loud alarm rang, Adam slowly opened his sleepy eyes and whispered, "I have a hard test today, but I am quite ready!"
He got out of his warm bed, brushed his teeth carefully, and put on his clean blue school uniform.
At breakfast, his happy family ate together and talked about their culture and how working hard always brings great success.
Before leaving the house, Adam paused at the front door and thought, "I feel like I can score top marks if I stay very calm and focused."
He hugged his parents tightly, said goodbye, and walked outside to wait for the big yellow school bus with his friends.
On the morning bus, his good friend played a calm, happy tune on a small guitar to help Adam relax.
The long, difficult test questions didn't seem so scary after he took a deep breath and thought very carefully.
During the quiet test, Adam focused hard, answered the easy questions first, and then slowly moved to the hard ones.
He remembered that at his young age, he can develop great skills so his answers sound clear and good.
After acing the school test, Adam happily celebrated with his family by eating a big, delicious hot pizza.

Omar arrived in America to stay with his cousins Yasmeen and Adnan. His uncle and aunt were so happy to see him. They went to the house together. His grandma called on the landline to welcome him. The whole family sat together and talked happily.

In the morning, the family ate breakfast together. The uncle asked, "Where would you like to go, everyone?" The aunt said, "We could go camping in the mountains." Yasmeen said, "Let's find a beautiful lake and stay there."

Adnan said, "And let's go hiking! We could also go fishing at the lake." The uncle smiled and said, "Mountains, lakes, hiking, fishing... This means Yosemite!" Everyone was so excited. Yasmeen went online to find information about the trip.

Omar said, "I have never heard of Yosemite. What is it like?" Adnan told him, "It is a beautiful national park." They watched a documentary about it on a nature channel. The park looked fantastic with big mountains, lakes, and fish in the water.

The uncle got a map and showed everyone the trip. He checked the weather forecast on his phone. No hurricane or serious storms this week! Yasmeen said, "We went on a school trip last year. It was so beautiful!" Omar was excited and could not wait.

The aunt asked, "Has everyone put their things in the car?" Omar was taking his things out of the house at the moment. Adnan could not find his trainers. Yasmeen said, "You are so slow, Adnan! Let's help him so we can leave." Grandma called on the phone and said, "Have a safe trip!"

They got in the car and started driving at a good speed. On the way, Yasmeen said, "We are getting hungry, Dad! Is it still very far?" The uncle said, "No, we have already passed the sign for Yosemite. We are almost there."

The aunt said, "You can eat the sandwiches in the bag next to your feet." Adnan said, "No, we can not. We have already eaten them!" Everyone laughed. The uncle said, "Do not worry, we will eat lunch when we arrive."

The uncle said, "Look! We are here! There are the mountains!" They saw the entrance of the national park. It was so beautiful. Omar opened his eyes wide and said, "This is amazing! I have never seen mountains like these!"

They went hiking near a beautiful lake and saw many fish in the water. They set up camp and had a wonderful time together as a family. Omar called grandma on the phone and said, "This is the best trip ever! Thank you, Uncle!"
